standing: Repository-grounded implementation descriptions, not evidence of effectiveness or guaranteed agent conformance. Refresh source hashes at capture time; changed sources require review.

facts.statement: Reason Commons is an installable skill for facilitating reasoning in an AI assistant. It is not necessary to have a separate Reason Commons hosted application to use the skill.
The skill instructions ask the assistant to capture contributions, nodes, links, attribution and unfinished reasoning in persistent YAML state.
facts.source_quote: Capture contributions as the conversation proceeds, maintain the trees in YAML

facts.statement: The skill supports reasoning about goals, problems, conflicts, proposed changes, obstacles and actions. It is not limited to one domain such as software teams.
facts.source_quote: Choose the tree that fits the question

facts.statement: The skill instructions distinguish proposed reasoning from explicit acceptance and disputes. Silence and viewing do not endorse reasoning; acceptance for now is not proof.
facts.source_quote: A view request, silence, or topic change is not endorsement.

facts.statement: The skill uses a working YAML file and local helper-generated history and diagrams. This does not establish simultaneous multi-user editing, a hosted shared workspace or automated follow-up.
facts.source_quote: History preserves previous wording and removed items

facts.statement: The repository workflow asks for a displayed change proposal, typed acceptance, a saved scope receipt and pull-request coverage checks. These checks cannot authenticate consent or prove implementation meaning.
facts.source_quote: Coverage checks cannot determine whether code inside an approved file fulfills the intended scope

facts.statement: This evaluation has not yet established visitor comprehension, conversion, adoption or improved decisions. Instructions and local technical checks do not establish these outcomes.
facts.source_quote: no visitor calibration has been established
